A.name: preserve-explicit-input-precedence
A.invariant: Explicit/local user input wins; fallback or defaults apply only when the explicit value is absent.

C.name: ensure-cleanup-on-all-exit-paths
C.invariant: Cleanup must complete across failure/early-exit paths before teardown errors are reported.

E.name: align-reuse-with-lifetime-scope
E.invariant: Reuse and cleanup must honor ownership/lifetime scope; nested ownership cannot tear down early.

G.name: prefer-specific-match-before-fallback
G.invariant: When multiple candidates can match, specific/local candidates must be considered before generic/global fallback.
